title: Unified SFI and Venture Author Post
description: The author-owned metadata contract. Draft values may be empty or null; the writing review and publish commands enforce publication completeness.

source.description: Canonical relative author-body filename inside this post folder: entry.md, entry.html, entry.txt, or an imported entry.docx. The metadata key remains source.

subtitle.description: The entry subtitle shown in the site header and indexes.

excerpt.description: A short, plain-text summary used in indexes and newsletters. Leave it empty while drafting to derive it from the first meaningful prose block on first publish.

entry.description: The global SFI/Venture sequence number. It is a string so leading zeroes are preserved.

date.description: Publication date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Leave it empty while drafting to stamp it on first publish, or supply a date for a retrospective entry.

time.description: Publication time in 24-hour HH:MM form. It is normally empty or null while drafting; first publish replaces any draft value with its stamp, and replacement publication preserves that stamp.

trip.description: Optional trip or grouping name for either blog. Venture posts require one before publication.

thread.description: Optional slug shared by posts that belong to the same story or trip thread.

slug.description: A unique NNNN-title-YYYYMMDD slug. An undated draft uses a provisional date suffix that is finalized on first publish. A manual override requires an explicit date.

music.description: Optional music tagline. Review requires a non-empty title and artist whenever this object is present.

blog.description: The entry's specialized home. Venture entries also belong to the SFI umbrella archive.

collections.description: Optional collection slugs such as northeast-115, national-parks, or travels.

status.description: Lifecycle state managed by the writing commands. Unpublished entries retain their original publication metadata and author files while their local generated records are withdrawn.
